translations.Fabra i Coats — Фабрика творчества: Fabra i Coats — Fàbrica de Creació
translations.Бывшая текстильная фабрика и городской ц: Former textile factory and municipal creative centre. Individual events have their own admission conditions.
translations.Часы работы не проверены; ориентируйтесь: General opening hours were not verified; refer to the selected event.
translations.Театр на Ла-Рамбле. Программа и условия: Theatre on La Rambla. Programme and admission conditions depend on the performance.
translations.Концертный зал на Carrer Nou de la Rambl: Concert venue on Carrer Nou de la Rambla. Check each event’s tickets and age restrictions.
translations.Ярмарка старых и подержанных книг: 75a Fira del Llibre d’Ocasió Antic i Modern
translations.Книжная ярмарка с 29 стендами: редкие из: A 29-stall fair for antiquarian and second-hand books. This record represents the verified Sunday session. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Municipal event page explicitly lists fr: Municipal event page explicitly lists free admission. Books are not free.
translations.Full primary announcement explicitly dat: Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-10-18.
translations.The full fair runs 16 October–1 November: The full fair runs 16 October–1 November. Municipal page lists Saturday 10:00–20:30 and Sunday 11:00–20:30 only. No weekday hours were inferred.
translations.Последний день городской ярмарки: продук: Final day of the municipal market fair, with food stalls, cooking demonstrations and music. Admission is free; food and drinks cost extra. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Municipal event page explicitly lists fr: Municipal event page explicitly lists free admission. Food and drink are sold separately.
translations.Экскурсия по Fabra i Coats: Visita guiada a Fabra i Coats: Fàbrica de Creació
translations.Экскурсия о текстильном прошлом фабрики: A guided visit exploring the textile factory’s history and its present role as a creative centre. Meet in the interior lobby; advance registration is required. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Municipal guided-visit announcement list: Municipal guided-visit announcement lists free admission with advance registration.
translations.Нужна предварительная регистрация или би: Advance registration or a ticket is required.
translations.Семейное представление с фокусами, танце: Family magic, dance and theatre in Catalan and Spanish. Recommended for ages 3 and up; 75 minutes. Official date page shows a buy link. Ticket endpoint did not render in the research tool; seat stock is unverified.
translations.Advertised from €10. Theatre says bookin: Advertised from €10. Theatre says booking fees are additional.
translations.Хоровая программа из произведений Лотти,: Choral music by Lotti, Palestrina, Monteverdi, Allegri and Scarlatti. Approximately 65 minutes without an interval. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Мариана Энрикес и Валери Майлз: ночной г: Mariana Enriquez y Valerie Miles: Ciudad nocturna
translations.Разговор о ночном городе, памяти и литер: A conversation in Spanish about the city at night, memory and literature. Important update: the organizer moved the event to the CCCB Hall. Free admission with limited capacity. Venue organizer confirms Hall; the older city listing still says Pati de les Dones.
translations.CCCB practical information explicitly li: CCCB practical information explicitly lists free admission.
translations.Пако Мир ставит сатирическую пьесу Педро: Paco Mir directs Pedro Muñoz Seca’s comic verse play. In Spanish, 95 minutes; recommended for ages 14 and up. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Advertised from €12; theatre booking fee: Advertised from €12; theatre booking fees are additional.
translations.Full primary announcement explicitly dat: Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-10-20.
Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-10-21.
translations.Инди-рок-группа отмечает 20-летие дебютн: The indie-rock band celebrates 20 years of its debut album. Show starts at 20:30. Venue and promoter confirm event and start time. Live Nation parsed page says “On sale soon”, so current sale status is unresolved; do not promise tickets are available.
translations.Venue advertises advance tickets at €56: Venue advertises advance tickets at €56 including fees.
translations.Наличие билетов требует проверки: продав: Ticket availability requires checking: the promoter page currently says “On sale soon”.
translations.Инсталляции и перформансы на пересечении: Installations and performances exploring art, technology, ecology and the body. Free admission. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Municipal programme and festival organiz: Municipal programme and festival organizer state that admission is free.
translations.Full primary announcement explicitly dat: Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-10-22.
translations.День показов и обсуждений необычных теле: A day of screenings and discussions of international television. Original languages, mostly English subtitles; free advance registration is recommended. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Organizer registration page states admis: Organizer registration page states admission is free; registration is recommended, not compulsory.
translations.Full primary announcement explicitly dat: Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-10-23.
translations.Use organizer programme over the city co: Use organizer programme over the city copy for individual sessions: organizer lists the vertical-format discussion at 10:40, while city copy says 10:20. The overall 10:00–22:00 day agrees.
translations.Городская встреча международного сообщес: The city’s international-community gathering, with talks, workshops and organizations supporting life and work in Barcelona. Free with advance registration. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Municipal event announcement states free: Municipal event announcement states free admission with advance registration.
translations.Full primary announcement explicitly dat: Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-10-24.
translations.Бесплатный вечер электронной музыки: Cha: A free electronic-music evening with Charlins, MARA BRAVO, Drunk At Vogue, Mats and DJ Tortuga. Ages 18 and up. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.Official Sala Apolo event page lists fre: Official Sala Apolo event page lists free admission; ages 18 and over.
translations.Концерт барселонского пианиста и автора: A concert by Barcelona pianist and songwriter Manu Guix. Doors open at 19:30; the show starts at 20:30. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.€22 advance plus booking fees; venue lis: €22 advance plus booking fees; venue lists €26 at the door. Total checkout price not checked.
translations.Трёхдневный фестиваль о технологиях, циф: A three-day festival about technology, digital culture and rights, with discussions, labs and workshops. An appropriate pass is required; prices vary by category. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed.
translations.City listing gives a broad €5.25–€419 pl: City listing gives a broad €5.25–€419 plus tax range. Because eligibility and pass scope were not checked, price remains null rather than implying a €5.25 general pass.
translations.Organizer and municipal announcement exp: Organizer and municipal announcement explicitly list 28–30 October 2026; the municipal timetable states starts from 10:00 on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.
translations.Начало с 10:00 по городской афише; время: Starts from 10:00 according to the city agenda; closing time is unverified.
translations.Выставка победителей международного конк: An exhibition of the international photojournalism competition’s winners. Online tickets €9, box office €10; Sundays from 15:00 are free with advance booking. The announcement was checked; ticket stock or admission is not guaranteed. This is a published exhibition date range. Displayed daily hours are venue visiting hours, not separate event sessions.
translations.General €9 online including fees / €10 b: General €9 online including fees / €10 box office; reduced €7. Sunday 15:00–20:00 free by reservation, released preceding Wednesday at 10:00, max two per person.
translations.Full primary announcement explicitly dat: Full primary announcement explicitly dates this event in 2026: 2026-11-06 to 2026-12-13.
translations.Closed non-holiday Mondays. Do not model: Closed non-holiday Mondays. Do not model as open continuously. Primary source has an irrelevant typo about “7 September” in Monday note; November hours above are explicit.
